subject: general
question:
E, F, G, H, P, Q, and R, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. F sits fourth to the right of E. Only R sits between F and H. H is NOT an immediate neighbour of E. Only P sits between E and G.

How many people sit between G and Q when counted from the right of G?
solution:
E, F, G, H, P, Q, and R, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. F sits fourth to the right of E.

2. Only R sits between F and H.

3. H is NOT an immediate neighbour of E.

4. Only P sits between E and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7a3d7a3ed8ef722c91c4edb2373a8c5fadbfc0c883bad7da05b0298648c1339.png] 

Two people sit between G and Q when counted from the right of G.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”.

1
